home.h1: Which apps do you need when you land?
home.sub: Pick a country to see what to install, how to set it up and how to pay there. Works without data.
home.countriesSub: We start with Czechia and its neighbours, more countries will follow.
home.whyH2: What you will find in EzWay

why.title: Arrival kit
why.text: A list of apps to install at home, and what each one needs: a local phone number, a payment card or mobile data.

why.title: Last verified
why.text: Every guide shows its verification date. You can confirm that it works or report that it no longer does.

why.title: Guides for foreigners
why.text: Step by step with screenshots: how to register without a local SIM and how to pay with a foreign card.

home.offlineH2: Save a country to your phone.
home.offlineP: After you arrive you need neither roaming nor mobile data.
